metadata.page_title: LIBSON-3635: Direct Uploads - Increase document size allowance for saveExternalCorrespondence sbs

text:
What is the Problem / Opportunity
---------------------------------

Currently the client uses saveExternalCorespondence SBS for the Advisers to save client documents onto the client correspondence tab on Sonata. 

The problem is that the saveExternalCorespondence SBS has a hardcoded file size limit of 2MB and the Adviser is not able to upload documents that are larger than this such as bank statements.

The opportunity is to enhance the advisor and client experience on the client’s web platform by updating this file size limit on the saveExternalCorespondence SBS.

metadata.page_title: LIBSON-3635: Direct Uploads - Increase document size allowance for saveExternalCorrespondence sbs
